code:
CMD ["node", "server.js"]   # exec form -- runs as PID 1
CMD node server.js            # shell form -- runs inside /bin/sh -c
caption: Exec form receives docker stop's SIGTERM directly. Northbridge standardizes on it everywhere.

code:
CMD ["node", "server.js"]

$ docker run northbridge/catalog:1.4
$ docker run northbridge/catalog:1.4 node debug.js
caption: Appending a command on docker run replaces CMD entirely -- no questions asked.

code:
ENTRYPOINT ["node", "server.js"]

$ docker run northbridge/catalog:1.4 --inspect
# runs: node server.js --inspect
caption: Arguments on docker run are appended to ENTRYPOINT, not substituted in place of it.
